name: Two alternating feature rows
purpose: Makes two big differentiating claims, each argued in a paragraph and backed by a customer quote beside a large image.
description: Two alternating rows inside container-medium/large: row 1 text left + square image right, row 2 image left + text right (stacking below 991, image first on row 2). Each text column holds a serif H3-size heading (56/48/40/32px), an 18px grey paragraph (can contain inline links and paragraph breaks) and a translucent quote card (italic quote, 2.5rem avatar, bold name, role with optional linked org). `preset` selects default copy and spacing per route: company (/company), corporate (/lms/corporate-lms, row 1 puts the heading after the quote), enterprise (/lms/enterprise, no reveal motion).

preset.note: Per-route spacing (corporate/enterprise use the mid-market row spacing) and reveal on/off; also the default-copy key.

evidenceNotes: /company and /lms/enterprise pass their own `rows` (near-copies of the preset with small wording changes); /lms/corporate-lms uses the preset copy as-is. /company passes no preset, so it falls back to 'company'.
Each row has a `blocks` order array; only corporate row 1 differs (['text','quote','title'], heading after the quote card). Treated as a layout knob, not modelled.
imageClassNames (per-row image aspect overrides) are layout knobs. CorporateLms wraps the section in an overflow-x-clip div because the reveal's x offsets would otherwise widen the page.
